featured_reviews.review_text:
I am so grateful to Dr. Maitreyee and Dr. Vishaal for giving me back my smile and confidence. I had a very complicated case of two missing front teeth due to a traffic accident when I was 11 years old. I had tried many treatments in Hong Kong, but none of them worked and I was left with dentures that would fall out easily. I was very unhappy and insecure about my appearance and it affected my life in many ways.

When I came to India, I consulted Dr. Maitreyee and Dr. Vishaal at Sure Smile Dental Clinic in Mumbai. They were very compassionate and professional and took up the challenge of solving my case. They devised a customized plan for me that involved Invisalign, gum surgery, and capping. They were very meticulous and attentive to every detail and made sure that I was comfortable and satisfied throughout the process. What amazed me is through surgery, they were able to create a strong base for my new caps where before they started, there was nothing present! They even painted the inside of the Invisalign sets to make it look like I had a tooth there, which was a very thoughtful touch.

The result was amazing. I now have fully aligned, beautiful, and strong teeth that look natural and feel great. I can smile without any hesitation and I feel more confident and happy. The best part is that they were able to think out of the box and the treatment did not cost me a fortune like it would have in Hong Kong. I am so impressed by the skill and creativity of Dr. Maitreyee and Dr. Vishaal and I highly recommend them to anyone who needs dental care. They are truly the best dentists I have ever met and I am so thankful to them for changing my life. 🙏🏻😊

I hesitate to even refer to this place as a “clinic,” because that word often evokes a sense of cold medical evaluation. This space feels quite different. It is thoughtfully designed, welcoming, and calming—more a place of care and reassurance than one of clinical anxiety.

Medical and dental procedures can be mentally unsettling, especially when one is fully conscious throughout, and what truly makes a difference is how comfortable and confident the patient is made to feel. That balance is handled very well here, and the procedure itself was smooth, with minimal discomfort and constant reassurance.

What particularly stands out is the consideration shown to family members accompanying the patient. Instead of being made to wait restlessly on a chair, they are accommodated in a separate, thoughtfully crafted niche designed for their comfort and well-being. The staff is polite and supportive, the overall atmosphere is calm and well-managed, and the charges are reasonable and transparent. While one naturally hopes not to need frequent visits, if the need does arise, this is certainly a place I will return to with confidence.

Based on my experience, I would strongly recommend Dr. Bharani and Dentalfix Clinic to anyone considering high-quality dental care in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Ashok Shital
featured_reviews.review_text:
My wife recently had dental fillings done at this branch. On the second day of treatment, the clinic insisted on an advance payment of ₹3,000 (final balance) before completing the fillings. When I objected — saying it felt unfair to demand full payment before the job was finished — they said it was “the rule here” and pressured us to pay. We reluctantly agreed, though it left us very uncomfortable.
The treating doctor assured us that if the fillings came off or failed within one year, they would redo them free of cost.
Unfortunately, the filling on one tooth dislodged completely within just 4-5 months. When my wife returned for help, they claimed the tooth now required a root canal — a much more expensive procedure — instead of honoring the free replacement promise.
This felt like a clear attempt to extract additional money after providing substandard work. The initial fillings were poor quality, and the clinic’s policies (advance full payment + quick upsell to RCT) left us feeling cheated.
I strongly advise others to avoid this branch. Get a second opinion elsewhere, and be cautious about clinics that demand full payment before completing treatment or give short-lived guarantees. Save yourself the hassle, disappointment, and extra costs we experienced.

I had a very disappointing experience with Sabka Dentist. I specifically wanted invisible aligners, but I was strongly advised to get braces instead and was assured that my teeth gaps would be filled 100%. I trusted their recommendation and continued the treatment for almost one year.

After the treatment, my gaps were still not properly filled. I was then given retainers and told to wear them for 6 months, after which they would be changed. However, after 6 months they refused to change them and simply told me to continue using the same retainers for another 6 months. Even after following all the instructions properly, my gaps are still visible.

What disappointed me the most is the lack of communication and aftercare. My messages are being seen but ignored, and I’m not getting any proper response regarding my concerns. I expected professional treatment and support, but my experience has been frustrating and upsetting.
My money got wasted!! Worst dentist ever!

Visited Sabka Dentist, Vile Parle branch on 11th May for my 11:00 AM appointment and had a very disappointing experience. Despite arriving on time, another patient was taken before me and I was made to wait around 45 minutes without any proper explanation.

I was initially quoted a discounted teeth cleaning price of ₹249 online, but right before the procedure I was told I had “more tartar” and would need to pay ₹500 instead, claiming the procedure would take 20 minutes. However, the cleaning was completed in barely 7–8 minutes, which honestly raised concerns about the quality of the treatment.

To make matters worse, I was still charged the full ₹500 at the time of payment despite the earlier discussion. The overall experience felt highly misleading, unprofessional, and unethical. Both Customer service and staff was also unhelpful and ignored my concerns.

Please be careful and don’t get misled by online gimmicks and promotional pricing.
